name: Silph Co. Boardroom & Boss Giovanni (10F–11F)
summary: Take the warp portal from 7F directly into the 11F executive penthouse. Confront and defeat Team Rocket Boss Giovanni to liberate the Silph Corporation. Report the crime to Officer Jenny in Saffron for +10 Karma. Speak with the Silph President to receive the Master Ball, claim an Up-Grade from the 1F receptionist, and choose a free Johto starter.

items.name: Master Ball
items.method: Gift from the Silph Co. President on 11F after routing Boss Giovanni

items.name: Up-Grade
items.method: Given by the front desk receptionist on 1F after Silph Co. is liberated

items.name: HP Up
items.method: Ground pickup in the 10F eastern mainframe room

items.name: Johto Starter Gift
items.method: Choice of Chikorita, Cyndaquil, or Totodile from the Silph President
